decisions.reason: Removing the call-to-action requirement does not alter the independently defined product benefits, claims, or source-material selections.
The call-to-action removal does not logically change the script's keyword sources, required terms, or wording constraints.
The visual realism and native-looking UGC criteria remain semantically independent of whether the video includes a call to action.
The deferred landing-page and tracking audit is unrelated to the video call-to-action requirement and remains unchanged.
